DefaultChoiceDisplayText.SourceString: Could you tell me more about her?
DefaultChoiceDisplayText.LocalizedString: Could you tell me more about her?

Message.SourceString: I feel my wife's hand on my shoulder. I thought it was Death's at first, but it's not. It's her.
Message.LocalizedString: I feel my wife's hand on my shoulder. I thought it was Death's at first, but it's not. It's her.

Message.SourceString: I can sense her happiness. Her calm. I cannot thank you enough, traveller.
Message.LocalizedString: I can sense her happiness. Her calm. I cannot thank you enough, traveller.

Message.SourceString: Do you need something, traveller?
Message.LocalizedString: Do you need something, traveller?

Message.SourceString: I remember when I first saw her. Someone had been stealing from our tribe. Taking meat and pelts.
Message.LocalizedString: I remember when I first saw her. Someone had been stealing from our tribe. Taking meat and pelts.

Message.SourceString: I was posted as guard. She was so noisy, I was surprised that no one had heard her steal from us before.
Message.LocalizedString: I was posted as guard. She was so noisy, I was surprised that no one had heard her steal from us before.

Message.SourceString: You’ve done an old garou a great kindness. Thank you, traveller.
Message.LocalizedString: You’ve done an old garou a great kindness. Thank you, traveller.

Message.SourceString: Her eyes locked onto mine, but she didn't stop or run away. She continued to load herself with spoils while staring at me.
Message.LocalizedString: Her eyes locked onto mine, but she didn't stop or run away. She continued to load herself with spoils while staring at me.

Message.SourceString: She kept that look until her last days. I saw it whenever she snatched food from my plate. And that was often.
Message.LocalizedString: She kept that look until her last days. I saw it whenever she snatched food from my plate. And that was often.

Message.SourceString: Ah, Cliodhna. I still serve myself too much food. Always for you.
Message.LocalizedString: Ah, Cliodhna. I still serve myself too much food. Always for you.

Message.SourceString: A traveller, I think.
Message.LocalizedString: A traveller, I think.

Message.SourceString: My wife chose this beautiful spot on the cliffs overlooking the sea. She said it would be the perfect place for a little wooden home.
Message.LocalizedString: My wife chose this beautiful spot on the cliffs overlooking the sea. She said it would be the perfect place for a little wooden home.

Message.SourceString: I always meant to build it for her, but time has made these old bones slow, and these eyes see nothing now.
Message.LocalizedString: I always meant to build it for her, but time has made these old bones slow, and these eyes see nothing now.

Message.SourceString: It’s a beautiful place. I can hear the waves from here.
Message.LocalizedString: It’s a beautiful place. I can hear the waves from here.

Message.SourceString: Would you help an old garou to build a wooden home that my wife would be proud of? Be sure it covers me.
Message.LocalizedString: Would you help an old garou to build a wooden home that my wife would be proud of? Be sure it covers me.

Message.SourceString: The home you once built me is now gone.
Message.LocalizedString: The home you once built me is now gone.

Message.SourceString: Ah…footsteps.
Message.LocalizedString: Ah…footsteps.

Message.SourceString: Tell me…does the house stand yet on the cliffs?
Message.LocalizedString: Tell me…does the house stand yet on the cliffs?

Message.SourceString: An old garou cannot build it alone. When the walls rise and the roof covers me, come speak to me.
Message.LocalizedString: An old garou cannot build it alone. When the walls rise and the roof covers me, come speak to me.

Message.SourceString: I can smell fresh timber on the wind. The house…it stands now, doesn’t it?
Message.LocalizedString: I can smell fresh timber on the wind. The house…it stands now, doesn’t it?

Message.SourceString: You’ve done an old garou a great kindness. Thank you, traveller.
Message.LocalizedString: You’ve done an old garou a great kindness. Thank you, traveller.
